entries.titleZh: 在双栏工作台中并排查看会话与代码/终端，拖拽移动标签页或使用分屏快捷键
entries.titleEn: Work side by side in the split workbench with draggable tabs, pane maximize, and canvas overview shortcuts
entries.reasonZh: 分栏比例、标签拖拽位置与面板焦点属于窗口视觉布局交互，由你在顶部标签栏与分割线上直接拖拽或按键完成。
entries.reasonEn: Pane sizing, tab drag-and-drop placement, and split focus are visual layout interactions controlled directly via the tab bar, splitter, or keyboard shortcuts.

entries.titleZh: 自定义左侧边栏固定入口与顺序，并固定常用的 Mini App 快捷图标
entries.titleEn: Customize pinned items and ordering in the left sidebar, plus pin favorite Mini App shortcuts
entries.reasonZh: 「自定义左侧边栏固定入口与顺序，并固定常用的 Mini App 快捷图标」属于当前窗口的个性化导航偏好，可在外观设置的「左侧导航栏」分区中按个人习惯勾选和调整顺序。
entries.reasonEn: “Customize pinned items and ordering in the left sidebar, plus pin favorite Mini App shortcuts” is a personal navigation preference configured interactively in Appearance settings under Left sidebar or from Mini App menus.

entries.titleZh: 筛选、重命名、复制、从任意轮次分叉（Fork）、归档恢复与导出会话记录
entries.titleEn: Filter, rename, duplicate, fork from any turn, archive, restore, and export sessions
entries.reasonZh: 这些操作依赖选中的会话、分叉轮次或删除确认；智能体可准确打开会话界面，由你挑选目标会话或历史节点。
entries.reasonEn: These actions depend on the selected session, chosen turn to fork from, or deletion confirmation; the Agent opens the session UI so you can pick the exact target.

entries.titleZh: 按会话自由切换模型、思考强度、内置工作模式、记忆开关与审批模式
entries.titleEn: Switch the model, reasoning effort, work mode, memory toggle, and approval mode per session
entries.reasonZh: 「按会话自由切换模型、思考强度、内置工作模式、记忆开关与审批模式」与你当前正在编辑的会话状态紧密相关；智能体可为你打开当前会话入口，方便你在输入框栏直观挑选模式与模型。
entries.reasonEn: “Switch the model, reasoning effort, work mode, memory toggle, and approval mode per session” is tied to the live session composer where you can pick modes, models, reasoning effort, and approval posture interactively.

entries.titleZh: 在输入框用 @ 挂载文件、工作区、设备、模型、ACP、会话与技能，并用 / 或 $ 触发斜杠指令
entries.titleEn: Attach files, workspaces, devices, models, ACP, sessions, and Skills with @, and run slash commands with / or $
entries.reasonZh: 「在输入框用 @ 挂载文件、工作区、设备、模型、ACP、会话与技能，并用 / 或 $ 触发斜杠指令」是在撰写消息时的实时上下文拼装与命令补全交互，由你在当前聊天输入框中点选确认后一并发送。
entries.reasonEn: “Attach files, workspaces, devices, models, ACP, sessions, and Skills with @, and run slash commands with / or $” is an interactive composer workflow where you pick context chips and slash commands while drafting your prompt.

entries.titleZh: 在对话中通过 @ 选择当前模式可用的 MCP 服务
entries.titleEn: Use @ in chat to select MCP servers available to the current mode
entries.reasonZh: “在对话中通过 @ 选择当前模式可用的 MCP 服务”需要用户在当前输入框选择服务并编辑草稿，没有可直接完成该交互的结构化 Command。也可通过工具名称或描述搜索所属服务；工具不会单独列出。目录按当前主机、工作区和模式过滤；Minimal 隐藏 MCP 入口。远程工作区暂不支持此选择器，Peer Host 必须协商 chat_mcp_catalog_v1 能力。
entries.reasonEn: “Use @ in chat to select MCP servers available to the current mode” requires the user to select a server and edit the current composer draft; no structured Command completes that interaction directly. Tool names and descriptions can find their owning server without separate tool rows. The catalog is scoped to the current host, workspace, and mode; Minimal hides MCP. Remote workspaces are unsupported; Peer Hosts must advertise chat_mcp_catalog_v1.

entries.titleZh: 划选对话文字添加多条编号「批注」合并提交，或发起不打乱主线的「侧边提问」
entries.titleEn: Select transcript text to collect numbered batch annotations or ask a focused Side Question
entries.reasonZh: 「划选对话文字添加多条编号「批注」合并提交，或发起不打乱主线的「侧边提问」」依赖你在会话消息中划选的具体段落与批注内容，开启文本选择工具栏后选中文字即可直接触发。
entries.reasonEn: “Select transcript text to collect numbered batch annotations or ask a focused Side Question” starts from highlighting specific text in the conversation transcript and writing your note or side question in place.

entries.titleZh: 在智能体运行中随时插话引导（Steer）、管理待发送队列、按 Esc 中断或恢复异常轮次
entries.titleEn: Steer a running turn mid-flight, manage queued follow-up messages, interrupt with Esc, or recover interrupted turns
entries.reasonZh: 「在智能体运行中随时插话引导（Steer）、管理待发送队列、按 Esc 中断或恢复异常轮次」取决于当前会话正处于思考、工具执行还是中断状态，你可在聊天输入框与队列条上直接操作。
entries.reasonEn: “Steer a running turn mid-flight, manage queued follow-up messages, interrupt with Esc, or recover interrupted turns” depends on the live execution state of the active turn and is controlled directly from the chat composer and pending queue bar.

entries.titleZh: 审阅工具与命令权限请求：支持允许一次、记住项目范围、批量放行或附理由拒绝
entries.titleEn: Answer tool and command permission prompts once, remember scoped project grants, batch-approve, or reject with feedback
entries.reasonZh: 「审阅工具与命令权限请求：支持允许一次、记住项目范围、批量放行或附理由拒绝」是保障你环境安全的人工审批边界，必须由你在桌面端或远控端亲自确认，智能体绝不会替你点同意。
entries.reasonEn: “Answer tool and command permission prompts once, remember scoped project grants, batch-approve, or reject with feedback” is an explicit human safety boundary that you confirm in the session or from a remote controller; the Agent never self-approves.

entries.titleZh: 在会话顶部目标条随时修改目标描述或清除当前目标
entries.titleEn: Edit the active goal objective or clear the session goal from the goal banner
entries.reasonZh: 目标工具只负责读取、创建和受约束的状态转换；修改目标文本与清除目标在当前会话顶部目标栏中由你直接确认完成。
entries.reasonEn: Goal tools cover discovery, creation, and guarded status transitions; editing objective text or clearing the goal is done directly in the session goal banner.

entries.titleZh: 用 /btw（或 Ctrl+Alt+B）随手发起临时「侧问」，以及在代码编辑器中使用内联 AI
entries.titleEn: Ask quick ephemeral side questions with /btw (or Ctrl+Alt+B) and invoke inline AI inside the code editor
entries.reasonZh: 「用 /btw（或 Ctrl+Alt+B）随手发起临时「侧问」，以及在代码编辑器中使用内联 AI」是在你当前阅读或编码位置即开即用的轻量交互，可随时发起或按取消键中止。
entries.reasonEn: “Ask quick ephemeral side questions with /btw (or Ctrl+Alt+B) and invoke inline AI inside the code editor” is an on-the-spot lightweight interaction launched from your active chat composer or editor cursor and cancellable anytime.

entries.titleZh: 展开工具胶囊查看调用详情，并查看、输入或终止正在后台运行的命令
entries.titleEn: Inspect tool call capsules and monitor, send input to, or stop background shell commands
entries.reasonZh: 「展开工具胶囊查看调用详情，并查看、输入或终止正在后台运行的命令」与会话中实时滚动的工具卡片和后台进程状态绑定，可直接在对话流中点开查看或控制。
entries.reasonEn: “Inspect tool call capsules and monitor, send input to, or stop background shell commands” is bound to live tool cards and background process activity inside the active conversation stream.

entries.titleZh: 点击上下文与用量徽章，透视系统提示词、规则、技能、MCP 与对话的 Token 构成及缓存命中率
entries.titleEn: Click the context and usage badge to inspect token breakdown across prompts, rules, Skills, MCP, and KV cache hits
entries.reasonZh: 「点击上下文与用量徽章，透视系统提示词、规则、技能、MCP 与对话的 Token 构成及缓存命中率」在当前会话状态栏按需估算并展开展示，点击分类即可预览具体注入的上下文片段。
entries.reasonEn: “Click the context and usage badge to inspect token breakdown across prompts, rules, Skills, MCP, and KV cache hits” is computed on demand from the session status bar so you can inspect and preview each context category interactively.

entries.titleZh: 用 /compact 压缩长对话、用 /init 生成项目 AGENTS.md 规范、热重载上下文或管理长期记忆
entries.titleEn: Compact long chats with /compact, initialize AGENTS.md with /init, reload context, and manage long-term memory
entries.reasonZh: 「用 /compact 压缩长对话、用 /init 生成项目 AGENTS.md 规范、热重载上下文或管理长期记忆」涵盖多个针对当前会话上下文与记忆库的交互动作，可通过聊天斜杠命令或会话与记忆设置执行。
entries.reasonEn: “Compact long chats with /compact, initialize AGENTS.md with /init, reload context, and manage long-term memory” combines session slash commands and memory maintenance controls that you trigger in chat or Sessions & Memory settings.

entries.titleZh: 从项目或会话右键菜单一键打开本机会话存储目录，方便手动备份或排查
entries.titleEn: Reveal the local session storage folder from workspace or session menus for backup and troubleshooting
entries.reasonZh: 需要用户选择工作区或会话，并在本机桌面文件管理器中操作；远程工作区打开本机保存的会话镜像，对端设备和 Detached Dispatch 会话不支持此操作。打开目录不会修改会话归属。
entries.reasonEn: The user selects a workspace or session and works in the local desktop file manager; remote workspaces reveal their locally stored session mirror, while peer and detached-dispatch sessions are unsupported. Opening storage does not change session ownership.

entries.titleZh: 创建与维护可被主智能体自动委派的个人级或项目级子智能体
entries.titleEn: Create and configure personal or project-scoped subagents that primary agents can delegate to
entries.reasonZh: 「创建与维护可被主智能体自动委派的个人级或项目级子智能体」涉及作用域选择（个人或当前项目）、提示词与模型配置，可在智能体页或项目资源页中直观完成。
entries.reasonEn: “Create and configure personal or project-scoped subagents that primary agents can delegate to” lets you choose personal or project scope, craft specialist instructions, and configure subagent behavior in the UI.

entries.titleZh: 悬停或点开智能体卡片，透视它的可用工具清单、Skills 与只读安全限制
entries.titleEn: Inspect each agent’s enabled tools, Skills, and read-only safety posture at a glance
entries.reasonZh: 「悬停或点开智能体卡片，透视它的可用工具清单、Skills 与只读安全限制」用于在界面上直观核对不同角色的能力边界与安全约束。
entries.reasonEn: “Inspect each agent’s enabled tools, Skills, and read-only safety posture at a glance” surfaces per-role capability summaries and read-only boundaries interactively in the Agents gallery.

entries.titleZh: 按智能体精细开关工具组、单个工具与 Skills，并随时一键恢复默认配置
entries.titleEn: Toggle tool groups, individual tools, and Skills per agent — with one-click reset to defaults
entries.reasonZh: 「按智能体精细开关工具组、单个工具与 Skills，并随时一键恢复默认配置」需要针对具体角色在工具组与技能组选择器中勾选确认，智能体会为你打开对应配置界面。
entries.reasonEn: “Toggle tool groups, individual tools, and Skills per agent — with one-click reset to defaults” uses interactive tool-group and skill-group pickers per agent profile so you can review and reset selections safely.

entries.titleZh: 把暂时不用的助理从侧边栏收起（完整保留人设与历史），需要时随时重新打开
entries.titleEn: Hide inactive assistants from the sidebar while keeping their persona and history intact, and reopen them anytime
entries.reasonZh: 关闭操作依赖用户选择的助理；助理空间保留完整目录，并提供重新打开入口。
entries.reasonEn: Closing depends on the assistant selected by the user; the gallery retains the complete catalog and provides a reopen action.

entries.titleZh: 直接编辑自动保存的 IDENTITY.md、SOUL.md 与 USER.md，用透明 Markdown 掌控人设细节
entries.titleEn: Read and edit autosaved IDENTITY.md, SOUL.md, and USER.md persona documents in plain Markdown
entries.reasonZh: 「直接编辑自动保存的 IDENTITY.md、SOUL.md 与 USER.md，用透明 Markdown 掌控人设细节」需要你在助理配置页的文档编辑器中审阅与撰写人设正文，所有改动会自动同步保存。
entries.reasonEn: “Read and edit autosaved IDENTITY.md, SOUL.md, and USER.md persona documents in plain Markdown” provides an interactive Markdown editor with frontmatter synchronization right inside the assistant configuration page.

entries.titleZh: 从助理主页直接选模型发消息开聊，并集中回顾与该助理的所有历史会话
entries.titleEn: Pick a model, send a quick message, and browse all past conversations from the assistant’s page
entries.reasonZh: 「从助理主页直接选模型发消息开聊，并集中回顾与该助理的所有历史会话」结合了快速输入草稿与历史会话点选，智能体可为你打开该助理主页以便立即开始。
entries.reasonEn: “Pick a model, send a quick message, and browse all past conversations from the assistant’s page” combines a quick message composer and session history list on the assistant’s detail view.

entries.titleZh: 为当前个人助理单独创建和管理定时会话与周期性自动任务
entries.titleEn: Create and manage scheduled sessions and recurring automated jobs scoped to a specific assistant
entries.reasonZh: 「为当前个人助理单独创建和管理定时会话与周期性自动任务」需要你在当前助理的定时任务区设定时间、提示词与启用状态，智能体也可通过定时工具协助管理。
entries.reasonEn: “Create and manage scheduled sessions and recurring automated jobs scoped to a specific assistant” lets you review, add, pause, or edit scheduled prompts scoped specifically to the selected assistant workspace.

entries.titleZh: 在「项目资源」页配置单项目的默认模型与模式，并集中管理项目权限、定时任务、子智能体与技能
entries.titleEn: Configure per-project default models and mode in Project Resources, alongside project permissions, schedules, subagents, and Skills
entries.reasonZh: 「在「项目资源」页配置单项目的默认模型与模式，并集中管理项目权限、定时任务、子智能体与技能」需要针对你选定的具体项目工作区读取并保存覆盖项与权限规则；可在侧边栏项目行点击「项目资源」图标直接进入。
entries.reasonEn: “Configure per-project default models and mode in Project Resources, alongside project permissions, schedules, subagents, and Skills” applies to a chosen project workspace and its live host catalogs; open Project Resources from the project row in the sidebar to edit them in one place.

entries.titleZh: 添加或移除「关联目录」，维护项目名称描述与工作区人设文件
entries.titleEn: Link or unlink Related Directories and maintain workspace metadata and persona files
entries.reasonZh: 「添加或移除「关联目录」，维护项目名称描述与工作区人设文件」涉及目录选择器、关联说明编辑及移除确认；智能体可带你定位项目入口，由你在界面中确认目录变更。
entries.reasonEn: “Link or unlink Related Directories and maintain workspace metadata and persona files” involves folder pickers, descriptions, and unlink confirmation in Project Resources so your directory bindings stay intentional.

entries.titleZh: 定制项目专属图标图案、配色或分别上传浅色/深色自定义图片
entries.titleEn: Customize project icons with presets and colors, or upload separate light and dark images
entries.reasonZh: 点击项目资源页的大图标，从工作学习或生活兴趣分类选择图案及颜色，或分别上传浅色、深色图片，预览后保存到工作区所属主机。
entries.reasonEn: Click the large icon on the Project resources page to choose a work/study or life/hobby icon and color, or upload separate light and dark images, preview them, then save on the workspace host.

entries.titleZh: 自动监听工作区文件变动，并在大型仓库监听中断时一键恢复
entries.titleEn: Watch workspace file changes automatically and retry the watcher if OS limits interrupt it
entries.reasonZh: 「自动监听工作区文件变动，并在大型仓库监听中断时一键恢复」由工作区生命周期自动维护，当你需要排查监听状态或手动重启监听时可在界面中查看与触发。
entries.reasonEn: “Watch workspace file changes automatically and retry the watcher if OS limits interrupt it” runs automatically with your workspace lifecycle and exposes live watcher status and retry controls when troubleshooting large repos.

entries.titleZh: 在本地工作区内按文件名、路径或正文快速检索定位
entries.titleEn: Search local workspaces by filename, path, or full-text content
entries.reasonZh: 「在本地工作区内按文件名、路径或正文快速检索定位」面向你在文件面板与全局搜索中的实时交互检索；若你直接向智能体提问，智能体也会用内置搜索工具自行查找代码。
entries.reasonEn: “Search local workspaces by filename, path, or full-text content” powers interactive search in the file panel and Global Search while the Agent also searches your codebase directly during tasks.

entries.titleZh: 直接从新建项目向导接入 SSH、Docker 容器或 WSL 远程工作区
entries.titleEn: Connect to SSH hosts, Docker containers, or WSL directly from the New Project wizard
entries.reasonZh: 「直接从新建项目向导接入 SSH、Docker 容器或 WSL 远程工作区」需要选择连接主机、完成认证并在远端目录浏览器中选定文件夹；智能体可打开新建项目向导供你完成连接。
entries.reasonEn: “Connect to SSH hosts, Docker containers, or WSL directly from the New Project wizard” walks through host selection, authentication, and remote folder picking in the New Project dialog after the Agent opens it.

entries.titleZh: 在「项目资源」与状态栏查看 Git 改动路径数、会话数、任务数及配置健康度
entries.titleEn: Check changed Git path counts, conversation totals, scheduled tasks, and config health
entries.reasonZh: 「在「项目资源」与状态栏查看 Git 改动路径数、会话数、任务数及配置健康度」汇总了当前工作区、连接与应用运行时的实时指标，可在项目资源页和状态界面直观查看。
entries.reasonEn: “Check changed Git path counts, conversation totals, scheduled tasks, and config health” aggregates live workspace, Git, and application health metrics for visual inspection in Project Resources and app status views.

entries.titleZh: 原生编辑与预览 Markdown、实施计划、LaTeX 编译文档，并在 PDF 中添加高亮与批注审阅
entries.titleEn: Edit and preview Markdown, implementation plans, and LaTeX builds, and annotate PDFs with highlights, notes, and ink
entries.reasonZh: 「原生编辑与预览 Markdown、实施计划、LaTeX 编译文档，并在 PDF 中添加高亮与批注审阅」面向文档阅读、排版编译与画布坐标批注等视觉交互，在工作区打开对应格式文件即可自动启用专属视图。
entries.reasonEn: “Edit and preview Markdown, implementation plans, and LaTeX builds, and annotate PDFs with highlights, notes, and ink” activates format-aware visual editors and annotation layers automatically whenever you open Markdown, plan, LaTeX, or PDF files.

entries.titleZh: 启用本地工作区加速搜索索引，实现毫秒级大仓库内容检索
entries.titleEn: Maintain accelerated local workspace search indexes for instant large-repo lookups
entries.reasonZh: Glob/Grep 可直接完成智能体搜索，而界面搜索索引的启停状态归属工作区搜索设置管理。
entries.reasonEn: Glob and Grep provide direct agent search, while UI search-index lifecycle is managed through workspace search settings.

entries.titleZh: 在本地桌面会话中直接粘贴剪贴板截图，或把本机文件与文件夹拖进聊天框
entries.titleEn: Paste clipboard images or drag local files and folders straight into Desktop sessions
entries.reasonZh: 该流程需要用户选择或提供本地附件；智能体可读取已经进入会话的文件，但不会自行声称完成了用户侧拖放或剪贴板选择。
entries.reasonEn: This flow requires the user to select or provide local attachments; the Agent can read files already in context without pretending it performed the user's drag, drop, or clipboard selection.

entries.titleZh: 在 Finder 或系统资源管理器中一键定位当前本机文件或文件夹
entries.titleEn: Reveal any local file or folder directly in Finder or your OS file manager
entries.reasonZh: 这是控制器本机的界面动作，且远程工作区路径不能回退到本机打开；智能体会打开文件入口，不会把目标机路径静默交给控制器系统。
entries.reasonEn: This is a controller-local UI action, and remote-workspace paths must never fall back to the local file manager; the Agent opens the file surface without silently reusing a target-host path locally.

entries.titleZh: 按「我的 / 智能体」分类查看、切换终端，或保存常用的终端启动配置
entries.titleEn: Browse and switch terminals across Mine and Agent views, and save reusable terminal configurations
entries.reasonZh: 这些操作依赖当前终端会话列表和活动面板；智能体可直接新建终端，并可用终端工具执行任务，而多会话切换与配置管理保留在界面中完成。
entries.reasonEn: These actions depend on the live terminal-session list and active panel; the Agent can create terminals and run commands via tools while multi-session management stays in the UI.

entries.titleZh: 自动检测系统可用 Shell（如 zsh、bash、PowerShell、Git Bash）并按需切换新建终端类型
entries.titleEn: Auto-detect installed shells (zsh, bash, PowerShell, Git Bash, WSL) and pick a default or per-terminal shell
entries.reasonZh: 「自动检测系统可用 Shell（如 zsh、bash、PowerShell、Git Bash）并按需切换新建终端类型」需要读取当前主机实际安装的 Shell 列表并由你挑选目标类型，可在终端新建菜单或终端设置中完成。
entries.reasonEn: “Auto-detect installed shells (zsh, bash, PowerShell, Git Bash, WSL) and pick a default or per-terminal shell” queries the shells installed on your host so you can choose one from the New Terminal menu or Terminal settings.

entries.titleZh: 在 Windows 上直接把 WSL 发行版作为项目工作区
entries.titleEn: Open a Windows WSL distribution directly as a Linux workspace
entries.reasonZh: 「在 Windows 上直接把 WSL 发行版作为项目工作区」需要读取当前 Windows 主机的发行版列表并由你选定 Linux 用户与工作目录；智能体会打开连接配置入口供你选择。
entries.reasonEn: "Open a Windows WSL distribution directly as a Linux workspace" requires listing distributions on the Windows host and choosing a Linux user and directory; the Agent opens the connection dialog so you can pick them.

entries.titleZh: 本机可被控制
entries.titleEn: Allow control of this device
entries.reasonZh: 请在当前设备的「设备与连接」概览中切换「本机可被控制」，选择其他设备能否连接这台设备。
entries.reasonEn: Choose “Allow control of this device” in the local Devices & Connections overview to set whether other devices can connect to this one.

entries.titleZh: 经 OpenBitFun Link 在任何网络连接你的设备
entries.titleEn: Reach your devices on any network over OpenBitFun Link
entries.reasonZh: 「经 OpenBitFun Link 在任何网络连接你的设备」由登录与本机可被控制开关决定，没有需要智能体选择的连接入口。
entries.reasonEn: "Reach your devices on any network over OpenBitFun Link" follows sign-in and the Allow control switch; there is no connection entry for the Agent to choose.

entries.titleZh: 查看扫码邀请链接
entries.titleEn: Show shareable QR invitations
entries.reasonZh: 「查看扫码邀请链接」涉及在屏幕上展示邀请二维码供手机扫描；智能体会为你直接打开「设备与连接」中的「手机或浏览器」连接面板。
entries.reasonEn: "Show shareable QR invitations" involves displaying a visual QR invitation for your phone; the Agent opens the Phone or browser panel in Devices & Connections directly for you.

entries.titleZh: 在手机或浏览器中打开同一界面，扫码配对并随时撤销
entries.titleEn: Open the same UI on a phone or browser, pair by QR, and revoke at any time
entries.reasonZh: 「在手机或浏览器中打开同一界面，扫码配对并随时撤销」涉及在屏幕上展示配对二维码供手机扫描并打开本机浏览器；智能体会为你直接打开「设备」中的「在手机或浏览器中打开」卡片。
entries.reasonEn: "Open the same UI on a phone or browser, pair by QR, and revoke at any time" involves showing a pairing QR code for a phone to scan and opening this computer's browser; the Agent opens the Open on phone or browser card in Devices directly for you.

entries.titleZh: 在应用内用邮箱验证码登录（或用 GitHub 在浏览器中登录）并查看身份状态
entries.titleEn: Sign in with an email code inside the app (or with GitHub in the browser) and check account status
entries.reasonZh: 登录需要账号持有人本人输入邮箱收到的验证码，或在浏览器中完成 GitHub 授权。GitHub 与邮箱是独立账号，各设备需使用同一种方式和同一账号。智能体可打开入口并读取非秘密状态，不能代替用户认证。
entries.reasonEn: The account holder must type the code sent to their email, or complete GitHub authorization in the browser. GitHub and email are independent accounts; devices need the same method and account. The Agent may open the entry and read non-secret status, but cannot authenticate for the user.

entries.titleZh: 查看同账号在线设备、系统型号、自定义设备别名与移除旧设备
entries.titleEn: Browse same-account devices, OS/model info, custom aliases, and device removal
entries.reasonZh: 「查看同账号在线设备、系统型号、自定义设备别名与移除旧设备」需要核对控制端账户下的具体设备并确认别名修改或移除操作（若只想让智能体列出可用设备，可直接调用远程派发的列出目标能力）。
entries.reasonEn: "Browse same-account devices, OS/model info, custom aliases, and device removal" requires selecting a specific device under the controller account and confirming alias edits or removal (to simply read the device list in chat, use list-targets on Detached Dispatch).

entries.titleZh: 在当前窗口直接操作同账号另一台电脑的工作区
entries.titleEn: Operate another computer’s workspaces in your current window
entries.reasonZh: 「在当前窗口直接操作同账号另一台电脑的工作区」会切换当前窗口显示的设备，需要你在「所有会话 › 按设备」或设备页明确选择目标设备。
entries.reasonEn: "Operate another computer’s workspaces in your current window" changes which device the window shows and requires an explicit device choice in All sessions › By device or on the device page.

entries.titleZh: 在派发前按需将任务所选的模型配置同步给目标主机
entries.titleEn: Sync required model configuration to the target before job submission
entries.reasonZh: 「在派发前按需将任务所选的模型配置同步给目标主机」需要核对目标端缺失的模型配置并由你确认跨机同步；智能体会打开派发准备入口保留可见确认。
entries.reasonEn: "Sync required model configuration to the target before job submission" requires reviewing missing model settings on the target and confirming cross-host sync; the Agent opens the dispatch preparation UI for your review.

entries.titleZh: 断线重连后自动保存、追加并完整恢复任务对话记录
entries.titleEn: Save, append, and reload reconnectable job execution transcripts
entries.reasonZh: 「断线重连后自动保存、追加并完整恢复任务对话记录」由会话界面随重连游标自动回填与持久化同步；智能体会直接为你打开对应的派发会话视图查看完整上下文。
entries.reasonEn: "Save, append, and reload reconnectable job execution transcripts" is synchronized automatically with resumable cursors in the session view; the Agent opens the dispatched session so you can inspect the full transcript.

entries.titleZh: 一键生成并打开可分享的在线访问链接
entries.titleEn: Create and open a shareable access link for any Page
entries.reasonZh: 「一键生成并打开可分享的在线访问链接」涉及在当前客户端生成带会话上下文的打开链接或复制到剪贴板；智能体会为你打开 Pages 管理页（公开链接也可直接通过列表读取）。
entries.reasonEn: "Create and open a shareable access link for any Page" generates an openable session link or copies it in the UI; the Agent opens the Pages scene so you can launch or share it directly.

entries.reasonEn: "Start, finish, or cancel voice dictation right from the chat composer" requires live microphone speaking and user-timed start/stop control; the Agent opens Voice settings so you can enable and use the composer mic.

entries.titleZh: 录音期间实时分块采集音频并直观展示准备与识别状态
entries.titleEn: Stream audio chunks during recording with live preparation and transcription status
entries.reasonZh: 「录音期间实时分块采集音频并直观展示准备与识别状态」随聊天输入框的实时录音会话自动工作；智能体会打开语音配置入口方便你检查麦克风与模型就绪状态。
entries.reasonEn: "Stream audio chunks during recording with live preparation and transcription status" runs automatically during an active composer recording; the Agent opens Voice settings so you can verify model and mic readiness.

entries.titleZh: 从右下角 Hi 悬浮窗或悬浮窗模式切换到实时语音通话，边聊边让助手跨项目执行或停止任务
entries.titleEn: Switch to a client-wide realtime voice call from the Hi dock or Floating Window mode to run or stop project tasks
entries.reasonZh: 「从右下角 Hi 悬浮窗或悬浮窗模式切换到实时语音通话，边聊边让助手跨项目执行或停止任务」依赖实时麦克风收音、双向音频流与你的口头指令；智能体会打开对应入口并将通话控制与任务进展保留在可见界面。
entries.reasonEn: "Switch to a client-wide realtime voice call from the Hi dock or Floating Window mode to run or stop project tasks" depends on live microphone input, streaming audio playback, and spoken commands; the Agent opens the voice setup and keeps call controls visible.

entries.reasonZh: 「在「宠物与助手」页配置实时语音开关、火山引擎 API Key 与音色角色」包含私密 API Key 凭据与音色选择，必须由你在设置界面亲自填写，不会经过大模型上下文。
entries.reasonEn: "Configure the realtime voice assistant toggle, Volcengine API Key, and voice persona" includes private API Key credentials and voice selection that you enter directly in Settings outside model context.

entries.titleZh: 浏览、下载、校验、修复或清理 SenseVoice 与 Qwen3-ASR 本机离线语音模型
entries.titleEn: Browse, download, verify, repair, or delete local SenseVoice and Qwen3-ASR speech models
entries.reasonZh: 「浏览、下载、校验、修复或清理 SenseVoice 与 Qwen3-ASR 本机离线语音模型」涉及磁盘空间占用、模型下载进度与删除确认；智能体会为你打开「输入与交互 → 语音」设置页操作。
entries.reasonEn: "Browse, download, verify, repair, or delete local SenseVoice and Qwen3-ASR speech models" involves disk space, live download progress, and deletion confirmation; the Agent opens Input & Interaction → Voice settings for you.

entries.reasonEn: "Cancel an in-progress local speech-model download anytime" applies while a model download is actively running; the Agent opens the Voice settings section where you can cancel it.

entries.reasonZh: 「选择「自动」或指定识别语言，并切换当前使用的系统麦克风」需要结合你当前插拔的音频输入硬件与口述语种偏好在界面点选；智能体会打开语音设置供你切换。
entries.reasonEn: "Choose Auto or an explicit recognition language and pick your active system microphone" depends on your connected audio hardware and language preference; the Agent opens Voice settings so you can pick the right mic and language.

entries.reasonEn: "Run a quick mic and recognition test in Settings with millisecond timing feedback" requires speaking a live test phrase and checking the transcribed output; the Agent opens the Voice diagnostics section for you.

entries.titleZh: 识别完成后将文字放回聊天输入框，方便补充修改后再发送
entries.titleEn: Place transcribed text into the chat composer so you can edit before sending
entries.reasonZh: 「识别完成后将文字放回聊天输入框，方便补充修改后再发送」在当前聊天输入框草稿中直接完成；录音结束后你可自由增删文字或附加文件，满意后再按发送。
entries.reasonEn: "Place transcribed text into the chat composer so you can edit before sending" takes place directly inside your live chat composer draft so you can refine wording or attach files before sending.

entries.titleZh: 在通用页切换简体中文、English 或繁體中文界面语言
entries.titleEn: Switch the UI language among Simplified Chinese, English, and Traditional Chinese in General

entries.reasonEn: “Switch the UI language among Simplified Chinese, English, and Traditional Chinese in General” lives at the top of Application & Interface → General in the graphical UI; the Agent can either switch the language option directly or open General settings for visual selection.

entries.titleEn: Check and download updates in the background, then confirm installation and restart or install later from About

entries.reasonEn: “Check and download updates in the background, then confirm installation and restart or install later from About” requires your confirmation after downloading before installing and restarting; the Agent opens the exact entry and keeps the remaining interaction visible to you.

entries.titleZh: 调整全局界面字号档位，或按 12–20 px 自定义像素大小并实时预览
entries.titleEn: Adjust global UI font-size presets or set a custom 12–20 px size with live preview
entries.reasonZh: “调整全局界面字号档位，或按 12–20 px 自定义像素大小并实时预览”适合边看实时预览边微调最顺眼的阅读比例；智能体会为你打开外观页字号区域。
entries.reasonEn: “Adjust global UI font-size presets or set a custom 12–20 px size with live preview” works best with visual inspection against the live preview card; the Agent opens the Appearance font-size section for you.

entries.titleZh: 固定、取消固定或调整左侧导航栏场景入口顺序
entries.titleEn: Pin, unpin, reorder, or reset left sidebar navigation entries
entries.reasonZh: “固定、取消固定或调整左侧导航栏场景入口顺序”涉及多项导航入口的可视化排序与显隐对照；智能体会直接定位到外观页“左侧导航栏”区域。
entries.reasonEn: “Pin, unpin, reorder, or reset left sidebar navigation entries” involves interactive ordering and visibility review across sidebar entries; the Agent opens the Left Sidebar section directly.

entries.titleZh: 微调或重置对话流内容区的首选像素宽度
entries.titleEn: Adjust or reset the preferred pixel width of the conversation stream
entries.reasonZh: “微调或重置对话流内容区的首选像素宽度”取决于当前显示器尺寸与个人视觉阅读习惯；智能体会为你打开外观页宽度调节项。
entries.reasonEn: “Adjust or reset the preferred pixel width of the conversation stream” depends on your monitor geometry and visual comfort; the Agent opens the Appearance width control for interactive tuning.

entries.titleZh: 配置客户端实时语音通话开关、火山引擎 API Key 与播报音色
entries.titleEn: Configure client-wide realtime voice calls, Volcengine API key, and voice ID
entries.reasonZh: “配置客户端实时语音通话开关、火山引擎 API Key 与播报音色”涉及本机语音服务 API Key 凭据录入与音色核对；智能体会直接打开“宠物与助手 → 实时语音通话”区域，不会代收你的密钥。
entries.reasonEn: “Configure client-wide realtime voice calls, Volcengine API key, and voice ID” involves entering your local speech-service API key credential and voice preference; the Agent opens Pet & assistant → Realtime Voice Call directly without handling your secret.

entries.titleZh: 下载、选择、验证、修复或删除本地语音模型（SenseVoice Small 与 Qwen3-ASR）
entries.titleEn: Download, select, verify, repair, or delete local speech models (SenseVoice Small & Qwen3-ASR)
entries.reasonZh: “下载、选择、验证、修复或删除本地语音模型（SenseVoice Small 与 Qwen3-ASR）”涉及本地模型体积对照、实时下载进度与完整性校验；智能体会为你打开语音模型管理区。
entries.reasonEn: “Download, select, verify, repair, or delete local speech models (SenseVoice Small & Qwen3-ASR)” involves model size review, live download progress, and integrity verification; the Agent opens the local speech-model section for you.

entries.titleZh: 在支持麦克风输入的客户端测试转写
entries.titleEn: Test transcription on a client with microphone input
entries.reasonZh: “在支持麦克风输入的客户端测试转写”需要用户选择输入设备并录制一段用于测试的音频。
entries.reasonEn: Test transcription on a client with microphone input by choosing a device and recording a short sample in that client.

entries.reasonZh: “配置智能体执行期间发送消息的默认行为（立即发送纠偏 vs 排队等待）”属于当前设备的交互手感偏好，智能体会直接定位到“输入与交互 → 消息发送”区域供你切换。
entries.reasonEn: “Choose whether messages sent during an active turn steer immediately or wait in queue” is an interactive input preference scoped to the active surface; the Agent opens Input & Interaction → Message Sending so you can switch modes.

entries.titleZh: 搜索和查看全局、智能体会话、代码编辑器、终端与 Git 等全部快捷键
entries.titleEn: Search and browse all shortcuts across Global, Agent Session, Code Editor, Terminal, and Git scopes
entries.reasonZh: “搜索和查看全局、智能体会话、代码编辑器、终端与 Git 等全部快捷键”包含当前系统的修饰键显示与你已有的自定义覆盖记录；智能体会直接定位到“输入与交互”页的快捷键分区供你检索对照。
entries.reasonEn: “Search and browse all shortcuts across Global, Agent Session, Code Editor, Terminal, and Git scopes” reflects your OS modifier symbols and any custom overrides you have saved; the Agent opens the Keyboard Shortcuts section in Input & Interaction so you can browse them.

entries.titleZh: 录制新快捷键、实时检测冲突、恢复单项或重置全部键位并点击应用保存

entries.reasonEn: “Record new shortcuts, detect conflicts live, revert single bindings or reset all, and click Apply to save” requires pressing physical key combinations on your keyboard, reviewing conflict badges, and clicking Apply; the Agent opens the Keyboard Shortcuts section directly.
